nl: Enable the setting `server.compression.enabled=true` in app.properties by removing the comment marker from its line. Other commented lines stay commented.
oracle_program: lines "app.properties" |> filter text == "#server.compression.enabled=true" |> replace "#server.compression.enabled=true" "server.compression.enabled=true" mode: literal
reference_bash:
python3 - <<'EOF'
import pathlib
p = pathlib.Path('app.properties')
t = p.read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
old = '#server.compression.enabled=true\n'
assert t.count(old) == 1
p.write_bytes(t.replace(old, 'server.compression.enabled=true\n').encode('utf-8'))
EOF
